title: [Bug] Degraded Code Generation Quality with Claude Sonnet Model
body:
**Bug Description**
the quality of responses on coding related queries and the approach that has been taken by Sonnet has become very bad lately. even with 'think hard' option, i get badly analysed and written code.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: gnome-terminal
- Version: 1.0.119
- Feedback ID: b82760cb-d94a-40df-8249-7e8aa2ed2773
